item.title: US to suspend visa processing for 75 countries starting next week
item.description: The State Department is freezing immigrant visa processing for 75 countries in an effort to clamp down on applicants it deems likely to become a public charge.

item.title: Wrightsville Beach historic cottage moved to Wilmington
item.description: The Town of Wrightsville Beach shared in a social media post that the historic Williams–Bordeaux Cottage has been moved.

item.title: 21-year-old facing involuntary manslaughter charge appeared in court
item.description: A 21-year-old man facing an involuntary manslaughter charge following a deadly shooting early Saturday morning in Wilmington appeared in court Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: 19-year-old arrested in New Hanover County and charged with death by distribution
item.description: A 19-year-old was arrested on multiple drug charges including death by distribution.

item.title: ‘Absolutely preventable;’ New Pender County manager takes over after $650K scam
item.description: A new Pender County manager has taken over in the wake of a vendor fraud scheme that resulted in the loss of more than $650,000 in public funds.

item.title: Burgaw seeks full control of occupancy tax amid tourism boom
item.description: Over the past few years, Burgaw has experienced a major boom in tourism and now the town’s mayor is wanting to take that revenue out of the county’s hands.

item.title: Iconic Cape Fear Memorial Bridge needs replacement, but funding falls short
item.description: For years, there have been conversations about the need to replace the aging Cape Fear Memorial Bridge.

item.title: Topsail High School announces new head varsity football coach
item.description: Topsail High School has named Terry “T.J.” Albert as the school’s new head varsity football coach. Albert brings more than a decade of head coaching experience and a lifelong connection to football.

item.title: More than 75 people gather in downtown Wilmington for vigil honoring Renee Good
item.description: The vigil comes just a few days after hundreds of people gathered for a protest against ICE on the steps of Thalian Hall last Saturday.

item.title: A part that broke on a UPS plane that crashed in Kentucky failed 4 times on other planes years ago
item.description: Boeing warned plane owners in 2011 about a broken part that contributed to a UPS plane crash that killed 15 last year but at that point the plane manufacturer didn't believe it threatened safety, the National Transportation Safety Board said Wednesday.
